defect: Facing capacity bounds recognised individual full-width obstacle strips but missed partial rectangles whose union covers the same strip. The resulting extreme projection allocation could be impossible despite a valid layout.

reproduction.before: Rejected after four paired start/completion callbacks; incumbent preserved at 40,40
reproduction.after: Accepted 40,8.3 after three paired callbacks; full-width control case also remains accepted

implementation: Sweep board boundaries and obstacle contact coordinates. At each candidate, union active perpendicular open intervals to determine whether any legal contact survives. Exact-touch points remain legal. Opposite-face and component-only envelopes are not used to prove blocked strips. No-free-contact cases keep broad bounds for exact solver rejection. Existing final geometry and facing gates remain authoritative.

verification.coverage: Axis swaps, reflections, compact/noncompact, contradictory directions, full/partial strips, opposite-face exclusions, deterministic geometry/receipts, incumbent preservation, paired callbacks and mixed per-term constraints
